land.productivityZonationDesc: Zone zonation maps represent a multi-temporal synthesis of high-resolution spectral imagery. By tracking historical NDVI trends over consecutive seasons, areas are classified dynamically into highly productive (stable high NDVI), moderate yield, and low-productivity zones (stressed/low biomass signature).
land.segmentationBoundariesDesc: Land area boundaries and acreage are calculated using spatial vector polygon calculation. By projecting pixel boundaries onto UTM grid projections, the system converts spatial imagery dimensions directly to acreage estimates with a standard error margin under 2.5%.

responses.default: I'm your AgriFlux AI! Ask me about crop yield, irrigation, soil health, climate risk, pests, subsidies, or drones.
responses.greeting: 👋 Hi! I'm AgriFlux AI. Ask me anything about farming, crops, or climate!
responses.yield: For optimal yield, ensure your soil NPK levels are balanced. Rice yields 3,500-5,000 kg/ha under good conditions.
responses.irrigation: Irrigation should be based on crop requirements and soil moisture. Rice needs 450-700mm per season.
responses.soil: Healthy soil holds pH 6-7, solid NPK, and >1.5% organic carbon. Add compost regularly.
responses.climate: Climate change increases drought risks. Use the Simulator to plan, and consider resilient crop varieties.
responses.fertilizer: Apply NPK based on soil tests. Split applications improve uptake efficiency by 20-30%.
responses.weather: Always plan irrigation around 7-day rainfall forecasts to save water and prevent runoff.
responses.sustainability: Farm sustainability measures fertilizer efficiency, water use, and soil health. Aim for >70 score.
responses.pests: Common pests like aphids and borers can be managed with integrated pest management (IPM) and neem oil.
responses.diseases: Fungal diseases spread quickly in high humidity. Ensure good spacing and use preventive bio-fungicides.
responses.market: Market prices fluctuate. Check the Market Analysis tab before harvesting to time your sale effectively.
responses.msp: The Minimum Support Price (MSP) is the guaranteed government price. Always compare local mandi rates to MSP.
responses.subsidies: The government offers subsidies for solar pumps, drip irrigation, and organic seeds. Check the Subsidies tab.
responses.drones: Agricultural drones can spray fertilizers 10x faster and help identify pest hotspots via multispectral imaging.
responses.satellites: Satellite imagery (NDVI) helps assess land vigor, predict yields, and verify farm size for loans.
responses.loans: Kisan Credit Cards (KCC) offer low-interest farming loans. Satellite verification speeds up approval.
responses.organic: Organic farming eliminates chemical costs and builds long-term soil carbon. Start transitioning incrementally.
responses.weeds: Manage weeds early before they compete for nutrients. Mulching and cover crops naturally suppress weed growth.
responses.harvest: Harvest at the correct moisture content (e.g., 14% for wheat) to prevent post-harvest fungal losses.
responses.storage: Store grains in cool, dry, well-ventilated silos or hermetic bags to prevent weevil infestations.
responses.machinery: Renting tractors or combine harvesters via local cooperatives is often more cost-effective than purchasing.
responses.livestock: Integrating livestock with crops creates a circular farm economy where manure acts as free fertilizer.
responses.seeds: Always use certified, high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds treated with fungicides for the best germination rates.
responses.insurance: Crop insurance (like PMFBY) protects against weather anomalies. Register before the sowing season begins.

cropHealthMonitor.ndviFormulaDesc: Used to estimate vegetation health, density, and chlorophyll concentration.
cropHealthMonitor.cause1: Clogging in drip irrigation emitters (Sector C14).

environmental.reqScl: Scene Classification Layer (SCL) for cloud/cirrus/shadow masking
environmental.reqGeo: Geographic Target: Tile T44NPM (Cauvery Delta Basin)
environmental.pipelineReady: Multispectral Ingestion Pipeline Ready (Awaiting L2A Raster Link)
environmental.illustrativeOnly: Illustrative benchmark only — NOT an in-situ certified measurement of an individual farm boundary.
environmental.provenanceNoteDesc: This profile reflects published ICAR-TNAU regional classification data for Thanjavur alluvial delta soils (pH 6.4, low available N). For operational field recommendations, an actual certified farm Soil Health Card must be uploaded.
environmental.archivedDesTitle: Archived Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES) Statistics:
environmental.ministryAgri: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India.
environmental.historicalRecordNotice: Historical record from Agricultural Year 1997–1998 (Whole Year). Macro district statistic only — NOT a current seasonal yield target or individual farm productivity label.
environmental.desProvenanceDesc: These data are derived from the official Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare DES historical district database for Thanjavur district, Tamil Nadu. Official records reflect macro district aggregates and serve as historical agronomic baselines.
environmental.registryDesc: The environmental variables consumed across the AgriFlux intelligence pipeline are bound to immutable authoritative sources as mandated by precision agronomic governance standards.
environmental.governanceNotice: Environmental telemetry provenance governance complies with ISO/IEC 19115 geographic metadata standards and European Space Agency Copernicus open data licensing protocols.
environmental.variableRegistrySubtitle: Single typed source of truth across meteorology, orbital remote sensing, soil chemistry, and on-farm IoT sensors.
environmental.operationalSafeguardDesc: Reanalysis weather estimates, satellite NDVI, and district statistical benchmarks are displayed for macro-climatic and contextual monitoring. In accordance with safety rules, they are strictly decoupled from automated closed-loop irrigation actuators until physical on-farm capacitive sensor ground truth is verified.

about.title: AgriFlux AI: The Future of Precision Farming
about.subtitle: Bridging traditional agricultural wisdom and modern artificial intelligence to empower the next generation of farmers.
about.missionDesc: At AgriFlux, we believe every farmer deserves access to the most advanced intelligence to eliminate uncertainty in agriculture and maximize yield sustainability.
about.precisionDesc: We replace guesswork with science. AgriFlux analyzes your soil's unique DNA to provide exact nutrient recommendations for record-breaking yields.
about.climateDesc: Shield your crops from the unpredictable. Our predictive AI models simulate climate scenarios to help you stay ahead of weather risks.
about.marketDesc: Direct connectivity to global demand. We provide real-time market trends and verified trading channels to ensure you get the best price for your hard work.

landing.heroSubtitle: AgriFlux bridges satellite field telemetry, in-ground IoT soil monitoring, autonomous closed-loop irrigation, and expert agronomic consultations into one streamlined, easy-to-use platform for farmers, agronomists, and agricultural enterprises.
landing.mvpSubtitle: AgriFlux solves the core challenges faced by modern farms: unpredictable weather, water scarcity, fertilizer waste, and limited access to agronomic specialists.
landing.f1Desc: Deploy field sensors to track NPK ratios, root moisture, and soil pH continuously. When moisture falls below critical thresholds, automated drip valves trigger automatically and shut off when optimal.
landing.f1B1: Cuts water and electricity consumption by ~38%
landing.f1B2: Prevents root rotting and fertilizer leaching
landing.f2Desc: Farmers can connect directly with accredited agricultural specialists for customized soil treatments, crop rotation strategies, and organic disease remedies with direct synchronization between farmer and specialist.
landing.f2B2: Fast turnaround time for critical blight diagnosis
landing.f3Desc: Access high-tech spray drones, multi-row seeders, and tractors by the day without hefty capital investments. Purchase certified organic fertilizers and bio-stimulants directly from verified sellers.
landing.f3B1: Saves up to 60% on machinery capital expenditures
landing.f3B2: Verified quality and transparent per-acre rates
landing.workspaceSubtitle: Farmers and Agronomists each have tailored tools designed specifically for their daily tasks.
landing.cardCropHealthDesc: Real-time Sentinel-2 canopy vigor scans, automated pest infestation detection, and foliar disease alerts to protect yields.
landing.cardSoilDesc: Deep sensor analysis for NPK ratios, soil acidity (pH), root-zone moisture depletion, and organic carbon benchmarks.
landing.cardResilienceDesc: Predictive climate stress mitigation, biological biostimulant schedules, and drought-resistant seed switching recommendations.
landing.cardYieldDesc: Machine learning model estimating quintals/acre harvest outcomes based on rainfall patterns and soil profiles.
landing.cardClimateDesc: Forecasts extreme meteorological anomalies including flash heatwaves, unseasonal hail, and flood runoff.
landing.cardSimDesc: Interactive what-if scenario sandbox adjusting temperature, rainfall deficits, and humidity to stress-test crop viability.
landing.cardSustDesc: Quantifies farm biodiversity, carbon sequestration footprint, and chemical leaching risk with standardized ESG metrics.
landing.securityTitle: Enterprise-Grade Farm Data Security & Verified Audit
landing.securityDesc: Every reading from in-field IoT sensors, prescription from agronomists, and irrigation activation is verified and sealed in a tamper-proof activity ledger. This guarantees accurate, undeniable documentation for crop insurance claims, organic certifications, and farm credit evaluations.
landing.securityB1: Tamper-Proof Audit Trail: Farm activity and sensor logs cannot be retroactively altered or forged.
landing.securityB2: Verified Identity Access: High-security authentication via Email, Phone, or Google Sign-In with instant OTP.
landing.securityB3: Hardware Command Safeguard: Ensures automated irrigation valves only execute authorized instructions.
landing.securityB4: Bankable Farm Data: Export verified health and yield records for loans, insurance, and buyers.
landing.demoDesc: Try out the platform as a Farmer, Agronomist, or Administrator with preloaded telemetry and live features.
landing.footerMission: Empowering sustainable, high-yield agriculture through intelligent technology.
